name: special-purpose-item-read-and-not-written
source: EUROCONTROL-SPEC-0149-9 Edition 1.21, UAP (FRN 34 RE, FRN 35 SP) and the RE/SP item structure; built by hand from vector 01
reference: FRN 35 (I062/SP) set in the fifth FSPEC octet (0x02); SP is a length octet that counts itself (03) and two octets of content. The content is not mapped, so the record re-encodes without SP: the original block. LEN recomputed: CAT, LEN, FSPEC and items.
